nodes.text: China is reportedly witnessing a surge in human metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases, sparking concerns of another health crisis after COVID-19 pandemic. HMPV virus causes flu-like symptoms and can lead to severe respiratory issues, especially among children and vulnerable groups. https://t.co/2820Gox7yt
